images.title: 72 : 96 reduces to 3 : 4
images.purpose: Shows 72 : 96 reduced by its HCF 24 to 3 : 4, so 3 : 4 and 72 : 96 are in proportion.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. A short top to bottom layout: the big ratio, two division arrows, the simplest form, then the proportion.
images.exact_structure: Top centre, large: 72 : 96 in teal (#0072B2). Exactly two straight amber (#E69F00) arrows point down, one from 72 and one from 96, each labelled ÷ 24 beside it. Under the arrows: 3 : 4 in teal, 3 under 72 and 4 under 96. At the bottom, inside a thin reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded box: 3 : 4 :: 72 : 96. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

images.takeaway: Dividing both terms by the HCF 24 turns 72 : 96 into 3 : 4, so the two ratios are proportional.

image_decisions.why: The vertical layout shows one division on both terms leading to the same simplest form.
